tests.requirement: Constructional requirements for fire ENCLOSURES of ME EQUIPMENT

sub_tests.description: ME EQUIPMENT met this clause for alternate means of compliance with selected HAZARDOUS SITUATIONS and fault conditions in 13.1.2
Constructional requirements specifically analysed in RISK MANAGEMENT FILE
Flammability classification of insulated wire within fire ENCLOSURE is FV-1, or better, based on IEC 60695 series
Flammability classification of connectors, printed circuit boards, and insulating material on which components are mounted is FV-2, or better, based on IEC 60695-11-10
If no FV Certification, FV tests based on IEC 60695-11-10 conducted on 3 samples of complete parts
Fire ENCLOSURE - No openings at bottom or constructed with baffles/perforated metal/metal screen 2×2mm centre to centre with wire diameter at least 0.45mm
No openings on the sides within the area included within the inclined line C in Fig 39

ENCLOSURE, baffles, and flame barriers have adequate rigidity and are made of appropriate metal or non-metallic materials; FV-2 or better for TRANSPORTABLE ME EQUIPMENT, FV-1 or better for fixed or STATIONARY EQUIPMENT per IEC 60695-11-10

Overflow in ME EQUIPMENT - ME EQUIPMENT incorporates a reservoir or liquid storage liable to be overfilled or to overflow in NORMAL USE

sub_tests.description: Liquid overflowing from reservoir or chamber did not wet any MEANS OF PROTECTION liable to be adversely affected, nor result in loss of BASIC SAFETY or ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE

Maximum fill level indicated by marking; TRANSPORTABLE ME EQUIPMENT tilted through 10° or MOBILE ME EQUIPMENT exceeding 45 kg moved over threshold per 9.4.2.4.3 - no HAZARDOUS SITUATION or unacceptable RISK

tests.requirement: Soldered, crimped, and pin-and-socket connections of cables exiting ENCLOSURE include additional mechanical securing means

semantic_fragments.content: The device is not used in conjunction with oxygen rich environments, not used with flammable anaesthetics, and has no liquid reservoir. As a result, clauses 11.2.3 (SINGLE FAULT CONDITIONS related to OXYGEN RICH ENVIRONMENTS), 11.4 (flammable anaesthetics CATEGORY AP/APG), 11.5 (flammable agents), and 11.6.2 (Overflow in ME EQUIPMENT) are all marked Not Applicable (N/A).

Clause 11.3 constructional requirements for fire ENCLOSURES: Flammability classification of insulated wire within fire ENCLOSURE must be FV-1 or better per IEC 60695 series. Connectors, printed circuit boards, and insulating material must be FV-2 or better per IEC 60695-11-10. For TRANSPORTABLE ME EQUIPMENT FV-2 or better is required; for fixed or STATIONARY EQUIPMENT FV-1 or better is required. No openings allowed at the bottom of the fire ENCLOSURE; no openings on the sides within the area of inclined line C in Fig 39. These requirements are specifically analysed in the RISK MANAGEMENT FILE.

Clause 11.6.2 specifies that for ME EQUIPMENT incorporating a reservoir or liquid storage liable to be overfilled or to overflow in NORMAL USE: liquid overflowing must not wet any MEANS OF PROTECTION adversely affected by such liquid, nor result in loss of BASIC SAFETY or ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE. Maximum fill level must be indicated by marking, and no HAZARDOUS SITUATION or unacceptable RISK shall develop when the TRANSPORTABLE ME EQUIPMENT is tilted through 10°, or for MOBILE ME EQUIPMENT exceeding 45 kg, moved over a threshold per 9.4.2.4.3. This clause is N/A as the device has no liquid reservoir.
